clauses.quote: Unit members on support staff calendar prior to July 1, 1997 will receive a four (4) day extension each year they remain on support staff calendar.
A joint committee of the Association and the District will develop the calendars for the term of this Agreement no later than April 15 of the previous year except by mutual agreement.
clauses.subject_text: A joint committee of the Association and the District
clauses.notes: Joint duty; Union and District share responsibility.

clauses.quote: Representatives of all employees at a site and the administration shall analyze the impact of the proposed changes and develop written pros and cons.
clauses.subject_text: Representatives of all employees at a site and the administration

clauses.quote: All employees shall be presented the analysis and the pros and cons and given an opportunity to discuss and offer input.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is administration/District.

clauses.quote: A secret ballot (prepared by the District and the Association) vote shall be conducted among all employees at a site.
clauses.subject_text: A secret ballot (prepared by the District and the Association) vote

clauses.quote: District and Association representatives shall count the ballots.
If 70% + 1 of the staff vote to change the calendar, the results of this vote and the parent input shall be submitted to Cabinet for review and considerations for approval.
clauses.subject_text: the results of this vote and the parent input

clauses.quote: If the Cabinet approves the site request to change the calendar, it shall be recommended to the Board for approval.
Parents shall be provided the same information and opportunity as stated in 8.1.3.1 (a) (b) (c) above.
If the calendar changes are approved, transfer priority shall be given to unit members who will be adversely affected.
The specific dates for Open House, Back-to-School Night, and parent conferences shall be determined by the District.
clauses.subject_text: The specific dates for Open House, Back-to-School Night, and parent conferences

clauses.quote: Alterations to these dates may be made by sites with mutual agreement between administration and a majority of site-assigned unit members.
